note: WP-46 publishes no new page copy and makes no claim. Everything it lists in the command palette, the mega panels and the drawer is read from src/data/nav.ts and the route state at build time. The only new text is interface wording: the palette's labels, its status lines and the type chips on /search/ (Article, Research, Playbook, Guide, Template, FAQ, Glossary), which describe the interface and say nothing about WE.

sources.title: The navigation data every palette entry, panel link and drawer link is read from
sources.exact_url_or_locator: src/data/nav.ts, primaryNav, utilityNav, applyButton and footerNav (frozen; unchanged by WP-46, decision DP-3)
sources.next_review: when WP-40 or WP-50 changes the navigation data
sources.variables_units_scope: Labels, addresses and the one-line descriptions that are already published in the panels. No amount, no count, no date.
sources.methodology_limitations: Copied by code, not retyped. src/components/nav/commands.ts and panels.ts derive from the data; tests/unit/wp-46 proves the derivation and that the data is not changed.

sources.title: The title of the newest published research brief, shown in the Resources panel tile
sources.exact_url_or_locator: src/content/research (the entry with the latest publishedDate whose route is live), read in src/components/layout/Header.astro
sources.next_review: each time a research brief is published
sources.relevant_locator: newestResearch flag on the Resources section of src/data/nav.ts
sources.variables_units_scope: The brief's own title and its address. The tile shows no date and no count.
sources.methodology_limitations: A brief whose page does not exist is skipped, so the tile never links to a missing page; with no readable brief the tile keeps the text of the navigation data.
